summary: Specifies RObust Header Compression, a framework and four profiles that compress headers of RTP/UDP/IP, UDP/IP, ESP/IP and uncompressed packets, built to cope with lossy links such as wireless. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Every package has a long address label. If the labels are the same, you can write just a short code. ROHC does that even if some codes get lost.
